verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs say agents can start dev servers, open the app in a browser, click through UI flows, and verify their changes work. Cloud agents can control the desktop and browser and produce screenshots, videos and log references. A debugging guide covers reproducing issues, narrowing the root cause and verifying the fix. This amounts to driving a running app the agent launched itself, not attaching to and debugging an already-live application. missing for 10: attaching to an existing live/running web app, debugger features (breakpoints, stepping, console/network inspection) from within the assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
